values.summary: After fresh design approval and exact collision-free allocation, bind #342 in FastWork, revalidate preserved Episode 001, produce complete Episodes 002-010 in truthful checkpoints, run integrated package and negative proof, obtain exact-head editorial/audio review, and hand terminal package inputs to #262 without publication.

steps.action: Approve current identity, dependency graph, denominator, and exact #261/#262 path allocation before bind.
Revalidate preserved Episode 001 and produce complete Episodes 002-010 in package-complete checkpoints.
Run integrated package, audio, manifest, feed/enclosure-parity, rights, redaction, and negative validation.
Obtain exact-head editorial/audio review and prepare the non-publication handoff to #262.

invariants: Package claims are exact and checkpoint-local
Current repository identity is explicit in every lifecycle operation
risks: Legacy Episode 001 review may be stale at a future head
Artwork/feed paths overlap semantically with #261/#262 until exact allocation
Large audio artifacts can hide digest or metadata drift
Consent, rights, redaction, or synthetic-voice provenance can be overstated
stop_conditions: Unresolved exact path allocation with #261 or #262
Missing rights, consent, redaction, or provenance evidence
Need for deployment, provider, mailbox, directory, or publication action
